criteria.requirement: The opening identifies the first pending usable delivery consistently with the ordered plan.
criteria.pass_when: The opening and detailed order both identify read-only validated preview as the next usable result, with its prerequisite and preview-specific acceptance, including unchanged inventory. The overall confirmed-import goal is distinguishable. Equivalent prose and grouping are acceptable.
criteria.fail_when: The opening calls confirmed import or the whole workflow next while the detailed plan first delivers preview, gives only import acceptance for the next outcome, or leaves the reader unable to identify the next usable delivery.

criteria.requirement: Respect the read-only pilot boundary and the dependency of confirmation on a validated preview.
criteria.pass_when: Preview is useful without write capability; later confirmation consumes the exact valid preview and requires write capability. Acceptance covers invalid-tail nonmutation and stale or changed preview rejection before atomic application. Tests and relevant docs accompany delivery, preserving direct adjustments.
criteria.fail_when: Combines delivery so the pilot must wait for writes, permits confirmation before usable validation, mutates inventory during preview, or accepts partial/stale import. Merely listing parser/UI/test functions does not establish the dependency.

criteria.requirement: Keep planning actionable and scoped to unimplemented work.
criteria.pass_when: Links the agreed contract and existing checks, distinguishes proposed acceptance from any actually run baseline tests, and leaves implementation and review pending without inventing a process or code inventory.
criteria.fail_when: Implements the feature, asserts unperformed acceptance/review, reopens delivered direct adjustment work, or adds approval/release machinery without a concrete dependency.
